subfield: Theoretical physics: quantum gravity and quantum field theory
motivation: Maldacena's 1997 conjecture, made precise by Witten and by Gubser, Klebanov and Polyakov in 1998, established that a theory of quantum gravity in anti-de Sitter space is exactly equivalent to an ordinary quantum field theory on its boundary. This was the first concrete realization of the holographic principle. It changed how physicists approach the deepest question at the meeting of quantum mechanics and gravity. Because the dual description is unitary, black hole evaporation must preserve information, and holography later gave the quantitative framework (quantum extremal surfaces, islands) that reproduces the Page curve. The duality has also become a working tool beyond gravity. It gave the universal viscosity bound tested in quark-gluon plasma experiments at RHIC and the LHC, and new approaches to strongly correlated matter. Few ideas in recent decades have reorganized fundamental physics so thoroughly or connected so many fields.
